problem: Existing Viking source tunic has no delete_verts body mask. Shoulder, sleeve, armpit and waist skin became visible through the fitted outer outfit under final runtime deformation.
changes: Both native human bodies receive a real fitted inner cloth layer using native anatomical topology, weights and all nine morphs; exact source-face correspondence masks only its covered interior, retaining two boundary rings and exposed anatomy.
Lining is joined into the existing Clothing mesh; seven skinned parts and ten original animation clips remain. No hidden bones, substitute geometric characters or runtime enlarged garment.

The existing unprinted tunic cloth strip supplies the lining diffuse. Separate matte roughness .95 material deliberately has no unrelated outer normal/AO atlas; all original texture pixels are unchanged.

Independent renderer gate checks 756 final modifier poses/views with visible-skin zero tolerance and a renderer positive control. Original GLBs meaningfully fail the identical gate. Existing legacy/Viking material contracts remain mandatory.
Four actual world quality captures and a bounded timing sample extend the existing gameplay/save/UI driver. All prior workflow steps remain; new rendered coverage gate is added.
